Tactile materials, top-left warm key light, cool deep shadow, safe margins, small-size and circular-crop readability. No UI border, rarity frame, accidental writing, letters, watermark, transparency, mannequin, body, head, hands, held presentation, or crop.
Subject: Roadwarden Sash, a spellcaster's garment of woven cloth: a belt, seasoned veteran gear with fitted bronze fittings and tooled detail, themed for the frontier roads. Palette and materials: travel-worn umber, bronze buckles, deep teal. Construction: woven cloth caster garment with stitched trim.
Composition: One belt or sash laid in a readable loop or arc, buckle or knot as the focal point.
Input roles: the images control house style, lighting, material rendering and composition only; do not copy their objects, shapes, or ornament.
processing: Generated with gpt-image-2 images/edits at 1024x1024, quality high, one call per item, with a same-family shipped painting and two global style anchors as references.
Painted under the provisional id roadwarden_sash; the band was renamed before shipping.
Normalized deterministically to a 512x512 opaque sRGB source (cover resize, flattened).
Encoded to exact 128x128 WebP through scripts/convert_item_icons_webp.mjs at quality 82 with the hard 15 KiB gate.
